name: awesome-free-models
desc: A curated list of free AI models, APIs, and tools you can use without paying a cent.

resources.name: Muse Glimmer (Meta Superintelligence Lab)
resources.desc: Aug 2026. 30B dense multimodal model distilled from Muse Spark for local agentic workflows. Multi-step reasoning, tool use, vision, and failure recovery on consumer hardware (4-bit quant fits 24GB VRAM). 131K context. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Llama 4 Scout / Maverick
resources.desc: Meta's latest MoE generation. Scout: 109B, 10M context. Maverick: 402B, 1M context. Native multimodal. [[License]](https://github.com/meta-llama/llama-models/blob/main/README.md#llama-models-1)

resources.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
resources.desc: Apr 2026. 1.6T MoE (49B active). SWE-bench Verified 80.6% (top open-weight). 1M context. MIT license.

resources.name: DeepSeek V4
resources.desc: Core generation with extreme cost-efficiency. 1M context. MIT license.

resources.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash
resources.desc: Apr 2026. Efficiency-focused variant. 284B total (13B active). 1M context. MIT license.

resources.name: Gemma 4 31B / 26B MoE / E4B / E2B
resources.desc: Fully permissive Apache 2.0. 256K context, native multimodal. New standard for open-weight.

resources.name: Inkling (Thinking Machines Lab)
resources.desc: Jul 2026. 975B MoE (41B active). Leading US open-weight model. Native multimodal (text, image, audio). Apache 2.0. 1M context.

resources.name: GLM-5.2 (Zhipu AI)
resources.desc: 744B MoE model optimized for autonomous coding and engineering tasks. 1M-token context. MIT license.

resources.name: LongCat-2.0 (ByteDance)
resources.desc: Large-scale open-weight model for heavy agentic coding. MIT license.

resources.name: MiniMax M3
resources.desc: Frontier-tier 1M context, native multimodal + computer use. MSA architecture.

resources.name: Trinity (Arcee AI)
resources.desc: 400B parameter enterprise model. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Step 3.7 Flash (StepFun)
resources.desc: May 2026. Apache 2.0. Native multimodal (image+video), strong agentic performance. Efficient enough for high-end local hardware.

resources.name: Kimi K3 (Moonshot AI)
resources.desc: Jul 2026. 2.8T-parameter MoE (896 experts, ~50B active). World's largest open-weight model. 1M context, native vision + video. #1 Frontend Code Arena. Modified MIT license. Weights released Jul 27.

resources.name: Kimi K2.6 (Moonshot AI)
resources.desc: Apr 2026. 1T-parameter MoE model. Modified MIT license. Exceptional coding (SWE-Bench ~54%) and multi-agent swarm orchestration.

resources.name: Qwen 3.6-35B-A3B
resources.desc: Apr 2026. MoE variant with only 3B active parameters. Extremely efficient for consumer hardware. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: InternLM 3 (Shanghai AI Lab)
resources.desc: Early 2026. Strong long-context reasoning and agentic performance. Competitive in open-weight benchmarks.

resources.name: MiMo-V2.5-Pro (Xiaomi)
resources.desc: Apr 2026. 1.02T-parameter MoE (42B active). Optimized for complex agentic tasks, coding, and long-context.

resources.name: Kimi K2.7 Code (Moonshot AI)
resources.desc: Jun 2026. 1T MoE specialized for long-running coding agents. +21.8% over K2.6 on coding benchmarks. Modified MIT.

resources.name: Nemotron 3 Super (NVIDIA)
resources.desc: May 2026. 120B total (12B active). 1M context. Published weights, data, recipes, and eval infra. NVIDIA Open Model License.

resources.name: Phi-4 14B (Microsoft)
resources.desc: 2025. Compact 14B dense model. Strong reasoning and code. MIT license. Excellent for on-device and small deployments.

resources.name: Bonsai 8B (PrismML)
resources.desc: Apr 2026. Groundbreaking 1-bit quantized model. Extremely efficient for edge and consumer hardware (Apple Silicon).

resources.name: Aether-7B-5Attn (VIDRAFT)
resources.desc: Jul 2026. 100% open foundation model (weights, data, code, logs). 7B MoE (~3B active) with heterogeneous attention. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Mistral Large 3 (Mistral)
resources.desc: Jun 2026. 675B MoE (41B active). European multilingual flagship. Frontier-class reasoning, native multimodal. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Mistral Small 3.1 (Mistral)
resources.desc: Mar 2025. Versatile 24B multimodal model. Strong text performance with native image understanding and 128K context. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Mistral Small 4 (Mistral)
resources.desc: Mar 2026. Hybrid MoE (6.5B active params) unifying instruction, reasoning, and multimodal capabilities. Efficient frontier-class model. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Command A+ (Cohere)
resources.desc: May 2026. Enterprise multimodal MoE optimized for sovereignty and multilingual RAG across 48 languages. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Apertus 1.5 (ETH Zurich / EPFL)
resources.desc: Jul 2026. Fully open LLM (weights, data, training code). 8B and 70B with image understanding, thinking mode, and tool use. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Hy3 (Tencent)
resources.desc: Jul 2026. 295B MoE (21B active). Strong reasoning and agentic performance. Competes with models 2-5x its size. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Hermes 4 (NousResearch)
resources.desc: Feb 2026. Self-improving agentic model with closed-loop learning. Curates own memory and builds skills from experience. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Snowflake Arctic
resources.desc: Apr 2024. Enterprise MoE model balancing high-quality performance with efficient training costs. Optimized for complex data operations. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Falcon 3 (TII)
resources.desc: Dec 2024. Compact high-performance model with strong reasoning. Designed for efficient deployment on resource-constrained hardware. TII Falcon-LLM License 2.0.

resources.name: Apple OpenELM
resources.desc: Apr 2024. Family of efficient on-device SLMs using layer-wise attention scaling. Runs locally on Apple Silicon with full privacy. Apple Sample Code License.

resources.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
resources.desc: Jul 2026. 304B efficiency-focused variant. 1M context. MIT license. Fully self-hostable with GGUF support.

resources.name: Gemma 4 (12B)
resources.desc: May 2026. Apache 2.0. Google's first laptop-class multimodal open-weight model. 256K context, native text/image/audio/video understanding.

resources.name: Llama 4 Scout
resources.desc: May 2026. 109B MoE, 10M context. Native multimodal. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Kimi K3
resources.desc: Jul 2026. 2.8T-parameter MoE (896 experts, ~50B active). World's largest open-weight model. 1M context, native vision + video. Modified MIT. Weights released Jul 27.

resources.name: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B (PrismML)
resources.desc: Sep 2026. 27B reasoning model derived from Qwen3.8-27B. Ternary compression shrinks weights to ~8.5 GB while retaining ~98% of the base model's benchmark scores. Coding, math, tool calling, image understanding. 262K context. Runs on consumer hardware.

resources.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
resources.desc: Sep 2026. First model on DeepSeek's Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture. 552B MoE (8B active on input / 16B on output). Native image understanding, compressed KV cache (~1/4 of prior Flash) for agentic workloads. 1M context.

resources.name: GLM-5.3-FlashX (Z.ai)
resources.desc: Sep 2026. High-speed variant of GLM-5.3-Flash (320B total / 18B active, hybrid sparse + linear attention). Native multimodal, up to 200 tokens/s. Suited for coding, visual understanding, and long-horizon agent tasks. 1M context.

resources.name: Ling 3.0 Flash VL (inclusionAI)
resources.desc: Sep 2026. 124B MoE (5.5B active). Builds on Ling 3.0 Flash with native visual perception and visual-agent capabilities. Hybrid instant/reasoning model with tool calling. 262K context. A free variant is available on OpenRouter.

resources.name: Google AI Studio
resources.desc: ~15 free models — Most generous free tier. Rate-limited free access to Gemini 3.x Flash / Flash-Lite models (Gemini 2.0 Flash was shut down Jun 1, 2026). Generous limits for prototyping, no credit card required.

resources.name: OpenRouter
resources.desc: ~21 free models — Aggregates 450+ models. Filter by "Free" to see models available at no cost. Note: free models require a positive credit balance (balance may be $0). Includes experimental and subsidized open-weight models. Note: the free lineup churns constantly — treat this as a snapshot.

resources.name: AnyAPI
resources.desc: 15 free models — 400+ models with OpenAI-compatible API. Free tier: 100K tokens/day, unlimited users. Includes free and basic models. No credit card required.

resources.name: Groq
resources.desc: 12 free models — Ultra-fast LPU inference. Free tier includes Llama 3.x/4, Qwen, GPT-OSS, and Whisper models with generous daily rate limits (no credit card).

resources.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
resources.desc: Free tier is only $0.10/month for free accounts ($2.00/month for PRO/Team) — Free access to thousands of community models. Effectively unusable at that allowance; pay-as-you-go for anything real.

resources.name: NVIDIA NIM
resources.desc: 100+ free models — Free, rate-limited API access to accelerated versions of Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and more on NVIDIA infrastructure.

resources.name: DeepInfra
resources.desc: ⚠️ No free tier. Their pricing page states you must add a card or pre-pay before you can use the service. Serverless inference for popular open-source models.

resources.name: Together AI
resources.desc: ⚠️ Mostly paid, but at least one model is genuinely $0: Ternary Bonsai 27B is listed at $0.00 input / $0.00 output. Everything else is per-token, and a minimum credit purchase is typically required. Fast inference on many open-source models.

resources.name: Fireworks AI
resources.desc: ⚠️ No free models; ~$1 signup credit only. Optimized for low latency on open-source models.

resources.name: SiliconFlow
resources.desc: 15+ free models — Chinese platform with a large free tier: Qwen-Image, Hunyuan-MT-7B, BGE-M3, bge-reranker-v2-m3, and others listed at ¥0. No credit card required.

resources.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
resources.desc: 50+ free models — Free tier for running select open-source models at the edge.

resources.name: Black Forest Labs
resources.desc: 2 free models — Free Flux 2 Dev and Flux Kontext Dev image generation via API. Rate-limited, no credit card required.

resources.name: Replicate
resources.desc: Limited free runs on select "Try for Free" models, no credit card required; then prepaid pay-as-you-go.

resources.name: Poe (Quora)
resources.desc: ⚠️ Free tier changed over time; link check returned HTTP 403 (may block automation). Previously reported reduction (~300 compute points/day); verify in your browser before relying on exact numbers.

resources.name: Qwen Studio (Alibaba)
resources.desc: Free access to Qwen 3.6-Plus, Qwen 3.6-Max, and other Qwen models via web chat and API. 1M token context for agentic coding.

resources.name: Ollama Cloud
resources.desc: Free cloud plan with starter models, starter usage credits, and 1 concurrent model; limits reset periodically. Exact limits require manual confirmation. Same ollama run command as local.

resources.name: Mistral AI (La Plateforme)
resources.desc: 12 free models — Free API tier with access to Mistral Large, Mistral Nemo, Codestral and more. 1 req/s, 500k tokens/min. Requires phone verification and data usage opt-in.

resources.name: Cohere
resources.desc: 15 free models — Free evaluation API key for Command R, Command R+, Embed, and Rerank models. 20 req/min, 1,000 req/month.

resources.name: DeepSeek Platform
resources.desc: Free API credits for new users (5M tokens). Access to DeepSeek V4, DeepSeek-R1, and other models. Generous free allocation.

resources.name: Hyperbolic
resources.desc: Open-access AI cloud with affordable inference. Pay-as-you-go GPU compute (payment method required). Note: free trial credits for new accounts are no longer prominently advertised (Sep 2026); verify in-account before relying on a free tier. Supports Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, and other open models.

resources.name: Novita AI
resources.desc: Free credits for testing 100+ models including Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, and Mistral. OpenAI-compatible API with competitive pricing beyond the free tier.

resources.name: Anakin.ai
resources.desc: 30 daily free credits for accessing multiple AI models. Web chat interface and API access. Supports GPT-4, Claude, and open-weight models.

resources.name: Nebius AI
resources.desc: Note: Free trial suspended July 13, 2026. Now steers new users to a ~$1 trial credit via Nebius Token Factory (formerly AI Studio), with a $25 minimum deposit for paid usage. Fast inference on NVIDIA H100 infrastructure.

resources.name: Fal.ai
resources.desc: Fast, serverless platform supporting Llama, Flux, and Stable Diffusion models. Note: free starter credits are not prominently advertised (Sep 2026); verify whether new accounts still receive credits. Pay-as-you-go beyond any free tier.

resources.name: Vercel AI Gateway
resources.desc: $5/month free credits for the AI Gateway. Proxy and cache requests across multiple LLM providers. SDK is open-source and free.

resources.name: AI21 Labs
resources.desc: ⚠️ $10 trial credits, valid for 7 days (not 3 months). Access to Jamba 1.5, Jamba 1.6, and other AI21 models. No credit card required to start.

resources.name: Amazon Bedrock
resources.desc: $200 AWS credits for new customers. Access to Llama, Mistral, Claude, Titan, and other foundation models via API.

resources.name: Microsoft Foundry (Azure)
resources.desc: $200 free trial credits (30 days). Access GPT-4o, Llama, Mistral, Phi, and other models via Azure's unified AI platform.

resources.name: RunPod
resources.desc: Free credits for serverless GPU inference. Deploy open-weight models as serverless endpoints. Supports Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, and more.

resources.name: Cerebras
resources.desc: ⚠️ Old "free tier" replaced (Jul 2026). Now $5 free trial credits that expire in 30 days after adding a verified payment method; no longer a permanent free tier. Ultra-fast inference on Llama, Gemma, and gpt-oss models. Note: Model availability fluctuates.

resources.name: BazaarLink
resources.desc: Free OpenAI-compatible API with auto:free routing to zero-cost models. No credit card, no trial expiry. 10 RPM, 130 req/day.

resources.name: Kimi API (Moonshot)
resources.desc: ⚠️ Free tier no longer shown on the platform (Sep 2026). New-account free tier and Kimi K2.5 (128K) are gone from the site; catalog is now K3 / K2.7 Code / K2.6 with per-token pricing. Verify in your browser before relying on free access. OpenAI-compatible. Note: rebranded from platform.moonshot.cn.

resources.name: Alibaba DashScope
resources.desc: Rebranded: DashScope → Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Bailian). Free tier for new users (100M+ free tokens) on Qwen models via OpenAI-compatible API. (dashscope.aliyun.com now redirects to Bailian.)

resources.name: SambaNova Cloud
resources.desc: ⚠️ Free plan tightened (Sep 2026). Still "no credit card required to start," but the free plan now says you must add a payment method and purchase credits to run your first requests; no automatic $5/30-day credits anymore. Fast RDU inference for Llama 3.1 405B, Llama 3.3 70B, DeepSeek V3.1/V3.2, Qwen 2.5, gpt-oss-120b.

resources.name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
resources.desc: 14 free models — EU-hosted, GDPR-compliant free tier. No registration required for anonymous tier. Models: Qwen, Mistral, Llama, DeepSeek, gpt-oss-120B, embeddings, image generation. 12 RPM. OpenAI-compatible.

resources.name: Chutes.ai
resources.desc: ⚠️ Free tier ended — now paid only. Was 2 free models for community-powered GPU inference. No longer free.

resources.name: ModelScope
resources.desc: 55 free models — Chinese platform with 50+ free open models. Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, and more. No credit card required.

resources.name: Z.ai (Zhipu AI)
resources.desc: 4 free models — Free tier for GLM models including GLM-4.5, GLM-4V. No credit card required.

resources.name: LongCat AI
resources.desc: Free API for LongCat open-weight models. One-time 10M token grant after signup + KYC. Free cached tokens. OpenAI-compatible. MIT license.

resources.name: Coze (ByteDance)
resources.desc: ⚠️ Rebranded (Sep 2026). Now positioned as an "AI Agent Intelligent Office Platform" (writing, PPT, web dev, design). The old "free bot-building platform with API access to GPT-4o/Gemini 1.5 Pro" pitch no longer matches the site; verify whether the bot-builder API free tier still exists.

resources.name: Free.ai
resources.desc: 400+ AI tools via a single OpenAI-compatible API. Free tier: 30,000 free tokens/day on self-hosted models plus 1,000 requests/month (60 RPM), no credit card required. Chat, image, video, music, voice, OCR, translation.

resources.name: Requesty
resources.desc: Free AI API with 200 requests/day. Works with Claude Code, Cline, Cursor. No credit card. OpenAI-compatible.

resources.name: AINative Studio
resources.desc: ⚠️ Free tier ended (was 10M tokens/month). Now a $5/mo Hobbyist plan with a 3-day trial only. 84+ models (Llama, DeepSeek, Mistral, Qwen).

resources.name: CloudCode.ONE
resources.desc: ⚠️ No free tier — credit-based ($2 to start). OpenAI and Anthropic-compatible API for coding agents. Powered by GLM-4.7-Flash.

resources.name: ZeroLimitAI
resources.desc: ⚠️ Free tier is only a 3-day trial; permanent access is a one-time $99 "Lifetime" purchase. OpenAI-compatible (model: "auto" auto-routes to the best free model). No subscriptions. 30-day money-back guarantee. Site intermittently returns HTTP 402 — retry if you hit it.

resources.name: FreeAIapikey
resources.desc: 100K free tokens daily — OpenAI-compatible gateway with GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 4.7/4.8/5/5.5, and Sonnet 5. No credit card, 9 models. $2 free credit on signup.

resources.name: Chat Oripe
resources.desc: ⚠️ Currently unreachable (HTTP 530). Previously offered free tokens via OpenAI-compatible API; service appears unavailable.

resources.name: FreeTheAi
resources.desc: Open-source Discord signup/free OpenAI-compatible API with 50+ models. No credit card. Small/community-run project (~20★, 1 fork); last commit Aug 2026 — treat as best-effort.

resources.name: OpenCode Zen
resources.desc: 9 free models — Curated AI gateway with free general and coding models (DeepSeek V4 Flash Free, MiMo-V2.5 Free, Nemotron 3 Ultra Free, Big Pickle, Qwen 3.6 Plus Free, MiniMax M3 Free, North Mini Code Free, and more). OpenAI-compatible API. No credit card required. Note: docs mark the free models as limited-time; Zen also offers a $20 prepaid balance option.

resources.name: LLM7.io
resources.desc: 15 free models, no credit card required. DeepSeek R1/V3, GPT-4o mini and more. 1M context, multimodal. 30 RPM free (120 RPM with optional token).

resources.name: Kilo Code
resources.desc: 12 free models, no credit card. Nemotron 3 Ultra, Step 3.7 Flash, and more. 1M context, ~200 req/hr. Free tier for coding agents. Note: acquired by Anaconda (banner on site); free "Auto Free" tier still advertised.

resources.name: Aion Labs
resources.desc: 7 free models, registration only. Includes Aion 2.5. 128K context, 15 RPM. No credit card required.

resources.name: Agnes AI
resources.desc: 5 free models — Free tier with Agnes 1.5/2.0 Flash and image models. 256K context, 30 RPM. Registration only, no credit card.

resources.name: Glhf.chat
resources.desc: ⚠️ Currently unreachable (HTTP 522). Previously offered a free OpenAI-compatible API; service appears unavailable.

resources.name: Nscale
resources.desc: 2 free models — Free tier (registration only) with Llama 3.3 70B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-70B. 128K context. OpenAI-compatible.

resources.name: OrcaRouter
resources.desc: 4 free models — DeepSeek V4 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen3.8 27B, and Tencent Hy3 at $0 per token, plus an orcarouter/free alias that auto-routes across the free lineup. OpenAI-, Anthropic-, and Gemini-compatible endpoints. No credit card and no trial expiry. The same page also gives away free vouchers for frontier models — e.g. $10 (~5M tokens) on Grok 4.5 — plus student programs and partner-hackathon credit, browsable without an account; each card shows its own terms and flags any card requirement.

resources.name: TypeSafe (Jev)
resources.desc: Structured decision models (System One family) that return a typed choice instead of free-form text, for routing and classification inside applications. Free output tokens on OpenRouter (typesafe/jev-latest); 32K context.

resources.name: FLUX.2-dev (Black Forest Labs)
resources.desc: 2.6K★. 32B rectified flow transformer. SOTA open T2I, single/multi-reference editing, in/out-painting. Updated VAE. FLUX.1-dev Non-Commercial License.

resources.name: ERNIE-Image / ERNIE-Image-Turbo (Baidu)
resources.desc: 0.5K★. 8B DiT SOTA among open-weight models. Strong text rendering, layout control. Turbo: 8-step generation. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Z-Image (Tongyi Lab / Alibaba)
resources.desc: 12.1K★. Open-weight T2I with strong GenEval scores. Z-Image-Turbo for 4-step generation. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: Pollinations.ai
resources.desc: Free image generation API. No API key or signup needed. Text-to-image, image-to-image. OpenAI-compatible. Integrates with ComfyUI.

resources.name: Kavel
resources.desc: Free image generation API. No API key or signup: send a prompt with any client id and poll for the image. Free output is 1K with a watermark and a small daily allowance per IP; an API key lifts it and adds image editing. SDKs for Python, JS, Go, Rust and more. GitHub

resources.name: OpenImageGen (Hugging Face)
resources.desc: Free, open-source image generation playground. Supports multiple community models via diffusers. Apache 2.0. Note: login/auth may be required (HTTP 401 at check time).

resources.name: FLUX Video Edit (Black Forest Labs)
resources.desc: Sep 2026. Prompt-based video editing: add, remove, or replace objects/characters, rebuild the setting, edit on-screen text, change colors/materials, translate dialogue with lip sync. Preserves source duration, aspect ratio, and audio. Source clips up to 15s / 50 MiB. Available via OpenRouter (paid per second).

resources.name: ComfyUI
resources.desc: 135K★. Node-based image and video generation UI. Run FLUX, Stable Diffusion, and more locally. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: 9Router
resources.desc: Open-source gateway connecting 40+ providers with RTK token compression (2-4x reduction). One API key for all services. Free-tier routing to Kiro AI (~50 credits/mo: Claude 4.5 + GLM-5 + MiniMax), OpenCode Free (no auth), and Vertex AI ($300 credits). Smart 3-tier fallback (Subscription → Cheap → Free). MIT license. GitHub

resources.name: OmniRoute
resources.desc: Full-stack AI gateway with 250+ providers, 90+ free. TypeScript, runs on Web/Desktop/Android. Prompt compression, 3-level proxy for geo restrictions. GitHub

resources.name: LiteLLM
resources.desc: Python-based proxy unifying 100+ LLMs behind a single API. Spend tracking, virtual keys, production-ready. MIT license. GitHub

resources.name: Portkey AI Gateway
resources.desc: Production guardrails and routing for AI apps. Hybrid open-source (community) and managed (enterprise) tiers. GitHub

resources.name: Ollama
resources.desc: The easiest way to run local LLMs. One command to download and run any model. macOS, Linux, Windows. GitHub

resources.name: LM Studio
resources.desc: Polished desktop GUI. Browse, download, and chat with models. Built-in model browser and local API server.

resources.name: llama.cpp
resources.desc: High-performance C++ inference engine. Runs on CPU and GPU. Supports GGUF quantization. Powers most other local tools.

resources.name: Jan
resources.desc: Open-source ChatGPT alternative for desktop. Built-in model downloader, local API server. GitHub

resources.name: GPT4All
resources.desc: ⚠️ Unmaintained — last commit May 2025 (last release Feb 2025). Privacy-focused local chatbot. Runs on consumer hardware. Built-in model browser. GitHub

resources.name: text-generation-webui (Oobabooga)
resources.desc: Feature-rich web UI. Supports multiple backends (Transformers, llama.cpp, ExLlama, AutoGPTQ).

resources.name: LocalAI
resources.desc: Drop-in OpenAI API replacement. Run models locally with an OpenAI-compatible API. GitHub

resources.name: KoboldCPP
resources.desc: Single-file executable for running GGUF models. Focused on story generation but general-purpose.

resources.name: llamafile (Mozilla)
resources.desc: Distributable single-file executables that run LLMs. No installation needed.

resources.name: vLLM
resources.desc: High-throughput production inference engine. Uses PagedAttention for efficient serving.

resources.name: SGLang
resources.desc: Fast inference framework with structured generation and RadixAttention.

resources.name: TensorRT-LLM (NVIDIA)
resources.desc: NVIDIA's optimized inference engine. Best performance on NVIDIA GPUs.

resources.name: ExLlamaV3
resources.desc: Optimized inference for Llama-family models. Successor to ExLlamaV2. Fastest option for single-GPU inference.

resources.name: Aphrodite Engine
resources.desc: High-performance LLM serving engine with advanced quantization support.

resources.name: TabbyAPI
resources.desc: Lightweight, fast OpenAI-compatible API server for ExLlama. (Originally ExLlamaV2; now targets ExLlama/ExLlamaV3.)

resources.name: LlamaEdge
resources.desc: Lightweight inference framework for edge devices. OpenAI-compatible API for open-source models. Runs on WasmEdge for portability. GitHub

resources.name: MLC LLM
resources.desc: Universal deployment engine by UW/SJTU. Runs LLMs on any hardware — laptops, phones, browsers. OpenAI-compatible API.

resources.name: WebLLM
resources.desc: In-browser LLM inference via WebGPU. Runs models directly in your browser with zero setup. No server needed.

resources.name: FastChat (LMSYS)
resources.desc: Open platform for training, serving, and evaluating LLMs. Provides OpenAI-compatible API and web UI for local models.

resources.name: Hugging Face TGI
resources.desc: 10.9K★. Production-grade serving toolkit for large language models. Note: Archived by Hugging Face (Mar 2026). Consider vLLM, SGLang, or TGI forks for active development.

resources.name: DeepSpeed (Microsoft)
resources.desc: Deep learning optimization library with inference acceleration. Enables running larger models on limited hardware through ZeRO optimization.

resources.name: AirLLM
resources.desc: Run large models (70B+) on consumer hardware with limited memory. Loads models layer-by-layer for extreme memory efficiency. Actively maintained (last push Aug 2026).

resources.name: Microsoft Foundry Toolkit for VS Code
resources.desc: VS Code extension to browse, test, fine-tune, and deploy models locally. Integrates ONNX and llama.cpp.

resources.name: Ollama Grid Search
resources.desc: Desktop utility for systematic model evaluation. Test multiple models, prompts, and inference parameters side-by-side via a Rust/React GUI.

resources.name: oMLX
resources.desc: 22.3K★. LLM inference server for Apple Silicon with continuous batching, tiered KV caching (hot RAM + cold SSD), and macOS menu bar app. OpenAI and Anthropic compatible. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: MTPLX
resources.desc: 2.5K★. Native MTP speculative decoding on Apple Silicon — ~2x faster decode with no external drafter. Mac app + CLI, OpenAI/Anthropic compatible server. Auto-tunes draft depth per machine. Apache 2.0.

resources.name: TensorSharp
resources.desc: Native .NET LLM inference engine and agent runtime for GGUF models. CUDA/Metal/Vulkan backends, multimodal support, Ollama/OpenAI-compatible APIs. BSD-3-Clause, free, runs fully locally.

resources.name: Open WebUI
resources.desc: Feature-rich ChatGPT-like interface for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible backends. RAG, image generation, multi-user. GitHub

resources.name: LibreChat
resources.desc: Open-source ChatGPT clone supporting 40+ providers, multi-user, plugins, and RAG. Note: company acquired by ClickHouse; repo actively maintained (last commit Sep 2026). Repo has moved to the LibreChat-AI org — the old danny-avila link redirects. GitHub

resources.name: AnythingLLM
